home.title: Countdowns
home.emptyBody: Add the date you're waiting for and watch the days go by.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: Optional — the date is shown when it's empty
editor.pinHint: The pinned countdown is the one your home-screen widget shows.
editor.pastNote: This date has already passed — the app will count the time since.

settings.title: Settings
settings.followSystemHint: Match your phone's light or dark mode
settings.showSecondsHint: Tick every second on the countdown cards
settings.countUpHint: Once a date has passed, show the time since it
settings.addWidget: Add the widget to your home screen
settings.addWidgetHint: Resizable — long-press it on the home screen and drag its edges
settings.addWidgetManual: Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Days Counter
settings.lockScreenNote: Phones and tablets that allow lock-screen widgets can show it there too.
settings.addWidgetIos: Touch and hold your home screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, then choose Days Counter
settings.lockScreenIos: On the lock screen too: touch and hold it → Customize → Lock Screen → add Days Counter
settings.resetBody: Every countdown will be removed. This can't be undone.
settings.aboutBody: Count down to the dates that matter — days, hours, minutes and seconds — and keep the next one on your home screen. Works fully offline; your countdowns never leave your phone.
